messages:
nina: quick follow-up from the postmortem today (INC-2026-091). summary: peering flakiness + tenant-eviction race caused customer 503s on dedicated/onprem. we need clear owners + short/med term mitigations.

devon: i'll own the peering hardening work (BGP hold timers, auto-restart policy, and preflight). plan: runbook + PR by 2026-05-02.

kai: i'll take tenant-eviction fixes (socket linger edge, gc timing) + tests. plan: patch, unit + e2e tests, and canary rollout to 2 clusters by 2026-04-29.

oncall-bot: Postmortem INC-2026-091 published: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-091. Remediation items added to the board.

lilly: customer wants an interim mitigation while fixes land. i can push a temporary routing rule (avoid affected AZs) and a traffic-split to fallback model instances. can deliver config + customer note by 2026-04-26.

nina: listing proposed action items to copy into the remediation board (please confirm owners + success criteria):

- P1: Peering hardening runbook + preflight CI job — owner: devon — due: 2026-05-02 — success: runbook in docs + automated preflight in CI that fails on misconfig
- P2: Tenant-eviction patch + canary rollout — owner: kai — due: 2026-04-29 — success: canary 10k reqs over 24h with zero eviction regressions
- P3: Temporary routing + traffic-split for impacted customer — owner: lilly — due: 2026-04-26 — success: customer confirmation + measured error rate drop
- P4: Staging synthetic that simulates peering flap and eviction race — owner: devon + kai — due: 2026-05-10 — success: alert fires and links to runbook
- P5: Compatibility matrix for on-prem kernel linger behavior — owner: kai — due: 2026-05-06 — success: docs updated and customer-facing note published
- P6: Cross-customer recurring-failures retro + 3 systemic mitigations — owner: nina — due: 2026-05-04 — success: retro notes + JIRA tickets created for each mitigation

devon: i'll add a checklist item in the runbook to validate routing-rule interactions and rollback steps. also adding `terraform plan` preflight and a smoke `curl` against the control-plane route.

kai: technical note: eviction race seems correlated with devices that keep `SO_LINGER` set to 1 on older kernels. mitigation = conservative reclaim delay + explicit socket drain before namespace delete. i'll include a feature flag for customers who need immediate opt-in.

lilly: i'll coordinate with ops-cs to get customer acceptance windows. i'll also draft the customer-facing mitigations note and include a recommended incident mitigation playbook.

oncall-bot: Reminder: remediation board sync Thu 09:30.

nina: please update the board rows with PR links, runbook draft links, and canary logs as they land. i'll follow up on 2026-04-30 to confirm P1/P2 progress. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
